value.answer: Call 911 now - a seizure like this needs urgent checking, especially with your child still floppy and drowsy after. Lay them on their side, keep the airway clear, and watch their breathing while you wait for help.
value.triage: This is an emergency: call 911 right away, don't wait to see if they wake up more on their own. After they're checked and stable, you can call 811 for any follow-up questions.
